title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
reasoning: The entire paper is centered on the 'Constitutional AI' method, which uses a set of principles (a constitution) to guide the ethical behavior of LLMs. It explicitly benchmarks and evaluates the model's ability to provide responses that are not only helpful but also 'harmless' and 'honest' (part of the HHH evaluation framework), using moral and ethical criteria such as those derived from figures like Martin Luther King Jr. and Mahatma Gandhi.
